column1: # B2 v2 candidates (coach CHANGES 30 Oct; mine only, no labels). Half-cells only (986, CSIR, 7 modules 297-299, 301, 333-335: low diversity).
# Proposer: FINAL members (p6_L3_100pct_s0-2 + p16_A_100pct_s3-4), mean softmax. a = crack px (p > 0.5); b_len = ellipse major axis of the
#   largest predicted crack component (underestimates curved / branched cracks); c = px of dark (< median - 20 GL) components >= 20 px,
#   elongation sqrt(l1 / (l2 + 1/12)) > 10 (length >= 10 x width), minor-axis sd sqrt(l2) <= 2.5 px (width about <= 10 px), not within 6 px
#   of the structural / frame mask (classes 1-9, 21, 22), consensus not 1-9, 21, 22, 17 or 11.
# GATE (numeric, stated before the numbers): pooled top-20 streak px within 12 px of gaps/frame 12.4%, (1); on dead_cell / inactive / structural 0.0% (2) (either > 50% -> drop c) -> gate mode abc
# Both gate conditions are weakened by the v2 exclusions. (1) measures only the 6-12 px band, because components within 6 px of gaps/frame are
#   already dropped. (2) is ~0% by construction. The real tests are the re-run OOF AUROC (with n_pos) and the user's hit rate on ranked vs the
# score = mean percentile rank of a, b_len within the half-cells (mode ab; see b2v2_gate.txt). 90 ranked (<= 13 per module) + 10 random (seed 0); panel order shuffled (seed 0).

# validation AUROC (v2, mode ab) 0.384 (A50, n_pos 4) / 0.437 (A20, n_pos 9), below chance; train scuffs are small full-cell scuffs, not the target context; the ranking is unvalidated; the 10 blinded random cells measure it. v1: 0.33 (A50, n_pos 4) / 0.40 (A20, n_pos 9).

# The streak score is non-zero in 14 of 986 half-cells (image-border artefacts) and is dropped. v2 is ranked on predicted crack px + largest-crack length: a list of crack-predicted half-cells, not a scuff detector.

# Random control power: 90 ranked vs 10 random, one-sided Fisher exact at p < 0.05. If 0 random cells are hits, the ranked list needs >= 25 hits (28%); with 1 random hit, >= 38 (42%); with 2, >= 48 (53%). At a 5% base rate the random arm expects 0.5 hits. Only a large gap is readable; similar rates mean 'no evidence either way', not 'the ranking fails'.

# Marks: scuff / crack / both / neither / unsure. Primary hit = scuff, crack or both (either is worth labelling; 0 half-cut cells are in train). Secondaries: 'both' (the E1 failure context) and scuff in any form. 'unsure' counts as not a hit for the primary and is reported separately. The power table applies to the primary hit.
# Mode ab by coach override (30 Oct): numeric gate said abc, but v2 c > 0 in 14/986 half-cells, all on image-border background outside the cell (artefact); c dropped.
